data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'arleon', meaning 'man of plough'. In ancient Greece, this name was given to a farmer or someone who worked the land. In Christianity, Arlie may symbolize hard work, dedication, and a connection to the earth and its bounty. The name Arlie carries the meaning “Man of plough” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arlie usually hope their child will grow to embody man of plough and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Arlie embodies the virtues of commitment, diligence, and humility.
